biotools.summary: Offline tool for cleaning tables of human gene and protein identifiers (TXT, CSV, TSV, XLSX). It maps approved symbols, aliases, previous symbols, Ensembl gene, UniProt, Entrez, RefSeq and HGNC identifiers to current HGNC approved symbols with cross-references, using a bundled HGNC snapshot. Excel date-corrupted symbols are recovered where the original is unambiguous and flagged for manual review otherwise; no input row is dropped. Each run records the tool version and HGNC release and writes a per-row audit table.

function.note: Map a table of mixed human gene identifiers to current HGNC approved symbols; ambiguous and unmatched rows are written to separate files.

bioconda.name: gene-tidy
bioconda.summary: No-code cleaning of messy gene/protein identifier tables, fully offline, with explicit ambiguity handling.
bioconda.description:
gene-tidy cleans messy human gene/protein identifier tables (TXT/CSV/TSV/XLSX)
by mapping them to current HGNC approved symbols plus Ensembl, UniProt, Entrez
and RefSeq cross-references. It runs fully offline against a bundled static
HGNC complete set, recovers Excel date-corrupted gene symbols (SEPT2 -> "2-Sep",
MARCH1 -> "1-Mar"), and never guesses silently: one-to-many and uncertain
mappings are flagged for manual review rather than resolved, and no input row
is ever dropped. Every run records the gene-tidy version and the exact HGNC
release used, and emits a paste-ready methods paragraph.
